about.title: About the project
about.educationalProject: Codenames Online is an independent, educational multiplayer web application developed by 42 students as part of the ft_transcendence project. The application was created for learning, development, and project evaluation purposes.
about.independentProject: The application is inspired by the word-association gameplay of Codenames. This project is not an official product, service, affiliate, or endorsed application of Czech Games Edition (CGE) or the Codenames brand.
about.policyPurpose: This Privacy Policy explains what information is processed while using the application, for what purposes this information is used, and what choices users have.

dataCollected.title: Information we may process
dataCollected.introduction: To provide the features of the application, the following information may be processed:
dataCollected.account: The email address, username, and password used to create an account and sign in.
dataCollected.password: Passwords are not stored in plain text; they are stored only in salted and hashed form.
dataCollected.profile: The avatar selected or uploaded by the user and other profile information.
dataCollected.gameplay: Game-related information such as joining game rooms, game results, and player statistics.
dataCollected.social: The interaction data required for the friendship, profile, and chat features to work when they are used, and the messages sent.
dataCollected.onlineStatus: Online status information that friends can see.
dataCollected.session: A short-lived JSON Web Token (JWT) and a refresh mechanism used to keep the session active.
dataCollected.language: The selected application language. This preference is stored in the browser's local storage so that it can be remembered when the application is opened again.

dataUse.title: How do we use the information?
dataUse.body: The processed information is used only for the operation of the application: managing the user account and session, providing profile, friendship, online status, and chat features, running multiplayer game rooms and gameplay, displaying game results and statistics, remembering the language preference, investigating errors, and improving the application.

visibility.title: Visibility and sharing of information
visibility.body: Due to the social and multiplayer nature of the application, some information may be visible to other registered users. This may include username, avatar, online status, activities in shared game rooms, game results, and shared chat messages. This project does not sell or rent user data, nor does it share it with third parties for advertising, marketing, or commercial purposes.

storage.title: Data retention and security
storage.retention: Account and application data is retained for as long as the account is active, or until the evaluation process of the ft_transcendence project is completed and the application server is shut down.
storage.security: When the application is deployed, communication between the browser and the server is encrypted over HTTPS/TLS. Passwords are not stored in plain text, and reasonable technical measures are applied to prevent unnecessary access to user data.
storage.sensitiveInformation: This application is a project developed for educational purposes. Users are advised not to share sensitive personal information in chat, profile, or other fields.

choices.title: Your choices and data requests
choices.body: Users can update their profile information and change their language preference in the areas provided by the application. To request the deletion of your account and associated data, you can contact the project team. Deletion requests are reviewed manually by the team, taking into account the technical scope of the project and evaluation requirements.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: This Privacy Policy may be updated as the application's features evolve. The current version is always published on the Privacy Policy page within the application. If a third-party authentication feature such as Google sign-in is added to the application, the information collected and the purposes of its use will be clearly updated before this policy is published.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy-related questions and requests, you can contact the project team via the GitHub repository or through 42 intra.

about.title: About the project
about.body: Codenames Online is an independent, educational multiplayer web application developed by 42 students as part of the ft_transcendence project. By using the application, you agree to these Terms of Service. The application is inspired by the word-association gameplay of Codenames. This project is not an official product, service, affiliate, or endorsed application of Czech Games Edition (CGE) or the Codenames brand.

accounts.title: Accounts and responsibilities
accounts.body: You are responsible for ensuring that the information you provide when creating your account is accurate and kept up to date. You are responsible for all activity carried out through your account and for keeping your username and password confidential. You must not share your password with others and should avoid reusing a password you use on other services. An account is intended for use by a single user; sharing accounts is not allowed.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.introduction: When using the application, you agree not to:
acceptableUse.harassment: Harass, threaten, or abuse other users, or post hateful, discriminatory, offensive, or unlawful content.
acceptableUse.cheating: Use cheats, bots, or automation tools, or exploit bugs, to gain an unfair advantage in games.
acceptableUse.impersonation: Impersonate another person or misrepresent your affiliation with any person or organization.
acceptableUse.unauthorizedAccess: Attempt to gain unauthorized access to other users' accounts, the application's systems, or its data.
acceptableUse.disruption: Disrupt, overload, or interfere with the normal operation of the application, including spamming or denial-of-service attempts.
acceptableUse.avatarContent: Use offensive, hateful, obscene, copyright-infringing content, or content that violates the rights of others, in your uploaded avatar image.

userContentAndIP.title: User content and intellectual property
userContentAndIP.userContent: You retain the rights to the avatar images you upload and the chat messages you send. However, for the application to function, you grant the project team a limited, non-exclusive license to store, process, and display this content to relevant users. You represent that you have the right to use the content you upload and that it does not infringe the rights of any third party.
userContentAndIP.intellectualProperty: The application's source code, user interface design, default avatars, and other assets are subject to their applicable licenses and attribution requirements. Source and license information for any third-party assets used is documented in the project repository.

enforcement.title: Suspension, termination, and project lifetime
enforcement.restriction: If these Terms of Service are violated, or if the safety of other users or the operation of the application is put at risk, the project team may restrict access to, suspend, or terminate your account.
enforcement.deletionRequest: As described in the Privacy Policy, you may request the project team to delete your account and associated data.
enforcement.projectLifetime: This project is for educational and evaluation purposes. The application and its server may be shut down once the ft_transcendence evaluation process is completed.

disclaimer.title: Service provision and disclaimer
disclaimer.availability: The application is provided "as is", as part of an educational student project. No warranty, express or implied, is given that the application will be uninterrupted, error-free, always accessible, or fit for a particular purpose.
disclaimer.liability: To the extent permitted by applicable law, the project team shall not be held liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of, or inability to use, the application.
